primary_claim: Clustering SAE decoder-weight-matrix feature vectors with HDBSCAN after UMAP dimensionality reduction finds a small number of highly interpretable feature clusters (e.g. cardinal directions, day-of-week/temporal units, word-sense groups like 'side') in GPT-2 Small and Gemma-2-2B SAEs, even though HDBSCAN classifies the large majority of features as unclustered 'noise' (over 90% in Gemma-2-2B, and at best ~35% clustered in any single GPT-2 Small layer).

effect.metric: percentage of SAE decoder features classified as noise by HDBSCAN
effect.value: over 90% of features classified as noise across all Gemma-2-2B layers; for GPT-2 Small at best ~35% of features could be classified into clusters, and only for a single layer

contradicts_or_qualifies: Extends Leask et al.'s (2024) HDBSCAN+UMAP temporal-feature-clustering approach to a broader set of interpretable clusters across GPT-2 Small and Gemma-2-2B layers, and reproduces Engels et al.'s finding of non-linear temporal feature geometry via 2D PCA
stated_future_work: Develop a Cech-complex-based algorithm for safety guardrailing/steering away from clusters of features, currently under investigation
Study filtrations of the Cech complex (varying the scale parameter epsilon) to identify significant topological structures via barcode visualizations
Conduct more inter-layer analysis and feature-level drift analysis across SAE layers
Open source the code, clusters, and UMAP projections
limitations_stated: Over 90% of features are classified as noise across all Gemma-2-2B layers, and depending on hyperparameters even the last layer of GPT-2 Small; at best ~35% of GPT-2 Small features could be clustered, for a single layer only
This high noise rate creates natural suspicion around the interpretability of the clusters that are found
HDBSCAN's tendency to classify most features as noise raises doubts about its efficacy for safety guardrailing applications (steering away from specific concepts)
quote: SAE decoder weight matrix alone can be used to find (some) feature families.
